Subject: SDK onboarding inquiry: CardinalPay -> Redwood

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're ready to start the SDK path for our payments platform and want to avoid any surprises around endpoint migration, retries, and throttles. High-level asks: 

- A recommended SDK install flow we can hand to our infra team (Docker/VM friendly).
- Best-practice retry and timeout defaults for user-facing flows (card auth) vs background jobs.
- Guidance on endpoint cutover: how to swap from our current provider to Redwood with minimal 5xx/latency regression.
- Any recommended rate-limit shaping on our side and what Redwood will enforce during onboarding.

I attached our current integration diagram for context (cardinalpay-arch-diagram.pdf). Can we do a short 30-min technical sync next week?

Thanks,
Sam Hayes
Senior Platform PM, CardinalPay
sam.hayes@cardinalpay.com
+1 415-555-0198

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SDK onboarding inquiry: CardinalPay -> Redwood

Hi Sam — great to hear and thanks for the diagram. Looping in our CSM and implementation lead so we can cover both onboarding timeline and runtime guidance.

Quick answers up-front and a short starter checklist below. I'll follow up with a MAP doc and sample code in a separate email.

1) Recommended install flow (summary)
- Provide a platform-agnostic SDK tarball (or Docker image).
- Two-step rollout: sandbox -> canary route (5–10% traffic) -> full cutover.
- Validate KV cache hot-warm behavior for long-running sessions (LLM token cache).

2) Retry & timeout defaults (opinionated)
- User-facing (synchronous): timeout = 3s, maxRetries = 2, backoff = exponential + jitter (base 250ms).
- Background jobs (async/batch): timeout = 20s, maxRetries = 5, aggressive batching enabled.
- Use idempotency keys for safe retries when possible.

3) Endpoint switchover guidance
- Start with DNS weight-based canary + route-based split on session cookies/headers.
- Monitor token-level latency and 5xx rate in first 30m; automatic fallback to previous provider if 5xx > 2% for 10m.

4) Rate limiting
- Redwood will enforce tenant-level soft limits during onboarding; we recommend shaping to 80% of your peak expected TPS for the first 72h.

Quick SDK init snippet (Node-like pseudocode):

const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY, timeoutMs: 3000, maxRetries: 2, retryStrategy: 'exponentialJitter' });

// call with idempotency key for retry safety
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-medium', prompt, idempotencyKey });

Starter checklist (attachments: redwood-sdk-quickstart.zip)
- [ ] Sandbox API key requested
- [ ] Basic generate call validated (latency/format)
- [ ] Rate limiter set to target 80% of observed peak
- [ ] Canary cutover scheduled (timezone windows)

I'll upload the MAP doc and a draft runbook after our sync. Proposed times: Tue/Thu next week 09:30–11:30 PT. Which works best?

— Logan Wright
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.com

Hi Sam — nice to meet you (virtually). I'm Vanessa, your CSM for this onboarding. I'll own the MAP (mutual action plan) and procurement coordination. Sharing a proposed 6-week onboarding cadence and the initial docs we use for cutovers.

Proposed 6-week plan (high level)
- Week 0: Kickoff + sandbox keys + procurement kickoff
- Week 1: SDK install + basic generate validation (sanity tests)
- Week 2: Canary route + observability plumbing (traces, token-level metrics)
- Week 3: Load tests, rate shaping verification
- Week 4: Production cutover window (low traffic)
- Week 5–6: Monitor + handoff to support/ops

Action items for CardinalPay
- Provide procurement contact and SOW expectations
- Provide security questionnaire answers (SOC2 scope, data retention needs)
- Run basic sandbox generate and share latency samples

Attachments: MAP-CardinalPay-v1.docx, rate-limit-guidance.pdf

I'll set up a shared Drive folder (link below) and create a short MAP doc. Proposed sync: Tue 2026-05-18 10:00 PT. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
